items.title: 8.5.2 Why is Intellectual Property Important? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of printed 8.4.2 Why is Intellectual Property Important? (PDF 203).

blocks.text: Intellectual property is liye aham hai ke yeh logon ko apne khayalat aur takhleeqat (creations) mehfooz rakhne mein madad deti hai. Jab koi nayi cheez ijad karta hai ya koi fan-para (art) banata hai, to intellectual property ke qawaneen yaqeeni banate hain ke us ka munafa sirf usi ko mile. Yeh hifazat logon ko naye khayalat aur innovations (jiddat) laate rehne par aamada karti hai, kyunke unhein maloom hota hai ke mehnat ka sila milega. Mukhtasar yeh ke intellectual property creativity ko sahara deti hai aur tarraqi ko aage barhati hai, kyunke banane walon ko apni mehnat ka faida milta hai. (Kitab ne yahan bhi 8.5 ke neeche number 8.4.2 chhapa hai.)
Maqsad: students rozmarra zindagi mein intellectual property ki mukhtalif qismein pehchanein.

items: Students class mein koi aisi cheez layein jo woh roz istemal karte hain, jaise mobile phone, kitab ya kapra.
Har student apni cheez se judi kam az kam ek qisam ki intellectual property pehchane (maslan brand ka naam, design ya content).
Baat karein ke intellectual property rights in cheezon ki hifazat kaise karte hain aur yeh banane walon ya companies ke liye kyun aham hai.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: mobile phone mein intellectual property ki kaunsi qismein ho sakti hain?
blocks.explanation: Phone ki nayi technology par patents; brand ka naam aur logo trademark; phone ki khaas shakal industrial design; aur us ka software copyright se mehfooz. (Misal hamari taraf se samjhane ke liye.)

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Kya aap jante hain ke Pakistan ka apna Intellectual Property Organization (IPO) hai? Yeh idara mulk mein intellectual property rights register (darj) karne aur un ki hifazat ka zimmedar hai, ta ke creators aur businesses ko un ki innovation ka sila mile.

blocks.prompt: Agar har invention ko koi bhi azaadi se copy kar sake to innovation par kya asar hoga?
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke mutabiq IP ki hifazat logon ko naye khayalat laane par aamada karti hai kyunke unhein sila milta hai. Agar copy karna azaad ho to mojid apni mehnat aur kharch ka sila nahi le payenge, is liye kam log naye khayalat par waqt aur paisa lagayenge aur innovation kam ho jayegi.

items: IP khayalat aur takhleeqat bachati hai; munafa banane wale ko milta hai.
Is se innovation aur tarraqi barhti hai; Pakistan mein IPO IP rights register karta hai.
